facts.fact: The Parliament of Uganda reports that the Uganda Communications Commission implemented the Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund under the Rural Communications Development Fund between 2016 and 2023 to promote broadband connectivity and access.
facts.system: Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund (UCUSAF)

facts.fact: Deputy Speaker Thomas Tayebwa said Shs110 billion was appropriated to fund the Uganda Communications Commission in 2024, of which only Shs55 billion was released.

UGA.note: Backbone extension by two loans is stated as future support, with no contract or works.
Nothing stated on local government offices.
No data price or share of income stated.
No rural electricity access figure stated.
No share of secondary schools with internet and no compulsory curriculum statement.
